pay_detail: Free for students in those three districts.
name: Mission Valley ROP high school career classes
what_you_do: You take hands-on career classes in 11 industry sectors and 59 career pathways. Some courses are linked to local colleges, so they may count for college credit.
who_can_apply: High school students in the Fremont, New Haven or Newark school districts. Charter, home school and independent study students should call to ask about the price.
deadline_text: Students sign up during pre-registration at their home school. The pages I read did not list 2026-27 dates.
how_to_apply: Sign up during pre-registration at your home school. Ask your school counselor, College and Career Specialist or Career Center for help with scheduling. Buses take students to and from the ROP center.
notes: Center is at 5019 Stevenson Blvd, Fremont. Phone (510) 657-1865. College credit partners named on the site: Chabot, Las Positas, Mission, Ohlone and Universal Technical Institute. Grade levels are not stated on the pages read. The site's jobs page for high schoolers only links to Indeed and a company careers page.
